name: .458 Cal-402gr Stone Hammer®
note: Recommended minimum twist rate for dangerous game hunting is 1-22″. Recommended use: Big game Hunting and Dangerous Game Hunting. The product page also says: "This 400gr class Stone Hammer™ will work in the slow twist old rifles as well as more modern 458’s. 1/4″ hollow point for rapid deformation to a min caliber frontal area with 90% weight retention and deep penetration. Box of 25."
